source: EmberEngine's own (2026-11-06): the Action Point (PA) rules every fight reads (engine/world/ActionPoints.cpp; docs/ACTION_POINTS.md). Values marked provisional are configuration defaults still to be balanced, not confirmed design.
maxApNote: the design's (the user, 2026-11-06): the AP scale runs from 1 to 34; no maximum goes over it; the HUD bar has 34 slots

armor.itemsNote: Every chest piece of content/data/overworld.json tables.equipment (slot chest) mapped by its id; the mapping follows the pieces' names (mail, cuirass, breastplate, brigandine, scale, leather, fur, robe) and is provisional until the designer confirms it. A chest piece missing here counts as the default category.
armor.classesNote: Enemies and neutrals carry no equipment data: their category comes from this table by class id, else the default. Empty until the designer assigns them (provisional).

weapons.categoriesNote: Every weaponType of content/data/weapons.json (and the off-hand daggers) folded into the cost categories; a type missing here keeps its own name as its category.
weapons.attackCostNote: dagger 5, sword/axe/blunt 6, polearm/bow 7 are the design's; staff (a staff's ordinary blow, never the Staff Counter) and unarmed (no weapon data at all) are provisional.
weapons.classWeaponsNote: Enemies carry no weapon data (Ember exports none): the category by class id, the same split MapStage::weaponStyle already draws (blades, spears, crossbows, staves); provisional. A class missing here uses default.

spells.defaultNote: the design's (the user, 2026-11-06): every spell and every special skill (weapon skills included) costs 8 AP; byKind / byTier override one

counters.byCategoryNote: a counter of any other kind costs the defender's own weapon attack cost unless listed here (e.g. dagger: 5)

movement.terrainNote: apCost null = the tile's own Ember moveCost (content/data/battle-rules.json: plains 1, woods 2, hill 2, ember 2, flame 3, nave/ruins/snow 1); modifier is added on top. The categories without a tile yet (road, uneven, mud, marsh, ice, rocky, shallowWater, magical) are configurable entries for terrains to come; nothing here is balanced.
movement.zonesNote: terrain altered by spells (Teia dos Sonhos, Tempestade de Gelo, auras, our zones): AP added to every hex they cover; provisional 0

statusNote: AP effects of the existing conditions, none designed yet. Keys: stunned, asleep, bleeding, crippled, fear, poisoned, diseased, hungry, hobble, sunder, rally, disarm, staggered, silence, mark, decay. Each {flat, pct, movementFlat, movementPct}.
talentsNote: AP bonus of a known passive / talent by spell kind, e.g. crusaderOath: {flat, pct}; none designed yet
equipmentNote: AP bonus of a worn piece by equipment id, e.g. capuz-de-viajante: {flat, pct}; none designed yet

examine.costNote: provisional: the final value is not established

ai.counterReserveWeightNote: the design's (the user, 2026-11-06): an enemy's strike scores exactly the AP it keeps in reserve after the walk and the blow, times this weight
